name: kindling-spark-os
description: Boot a minimal read-only OS image beside DGX OS on NVIDIA GB10 systems for local model-serving infrastructure.
compatibility: DGX Spark and ASUS Ascent GX10; Docker, NVIDIA container tooling, and mentat.
limitations: Beta software that changes the boot setup; read recovery instructions and back up the host first.
Built images can contain proprietary NVIDIA packages that upstream says must not be redistributed; check the licensing section.

sources.note: Upstream description, setup, and documented requirements.
